title: Daredevil: Born Again Season 3's Villain Officially Combines 2 Key MCU Characters
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Heather Glenn (Margarita Levieva) entered the new show as both Wilson and Vanessa Fisk's (Ayelet Zurer) couples counselor and Matt Murdock's (Charlie Cox) love interest. Clearly, nothing could go wrong.

Adding to this, That relationship put her in Muse's path: the Season 1 villain took her hostage and nearly killed her before Daredevil saved her, and Heather ultimately killed Muse in the episode "Art for Art's Sake."

Meanwhile, Fast-forward to Season 2, and Heather blamed vigilantes for enabling monsters like Muse, having broken things off with Matt, and working with Fisk's anti-vigilante administration, even falsifying psychiatric evaluations to help lock heroes like the Swordsman away for good.

Notably, All the while, Muse's ghost haunted her, and she secretly kept his mask rather than destroying it. By the Season 2 finale, her obsession and unresolved trauma devolved into something else entirely: Heather put the mask on herself .

As per the latest buzz, Season 3 set photos have since verified what that finale moment promised. Levieva was spotted on location in character as Lady Muse, dressed in a white shirt and long black trench coat with a beanie pulled over Muse's mask.
In further updates, The woman who killed Muse has officially become his successor heading into Season 3, and one of Matt's next major threats is someone he once saw a life together with.

On top of that, The show is borrowing from the comics, not adapting them directly, a classic MCU method. In Marvel Comics, the original Muse dies, and his evil spirit manipulates an unrelated character (a young artist named Morgan Whittier) into carrying on his legacy as the second Muse.

Heather Glenn has no connection to Muse in the source material; there, she's manipulated by the Purple Man instead. That character is known as David Tennant's villainous Kilgrave in the MCU, whom Cox has shared he'd like to see return in some fashion .

title: Q1 FY27: Suzlon Revenue Rises 23% YoY to Rs. 3,819 Cr; PAT Declines 6% to Rs. 305 Cr
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:
News EV+Storage Research Magazine Exclusive Blog Policy Solar Products Videos Powered by :

Adding to this, 28 Jul 2026 14:52 IST Follow Us Pune-based wind energy major, Suzlon Group reported revenue from operations of Rs. 3,819 Cr for the first quarter of Financial Year 2026-27 (Q1 FY27), compared to Rs. 3,117 Cr in Q1 FY26, registering a 22.5% Year-on-Year (YoY) increase. However, on a Quarter-on-Quarter (QoQ) basis, revenue declined by 30.2% from Rs. 5,468.06 Cr reported in the March 2026 quarter.

Meanwhile, Meanwhile, Suzlon's Profit After Tax (PAT) stood at Rs. 305 Cr in Q1 FY27, down from Rs. 324 Cr in Q1 FY26, reflecting a 5.9% YoY decline. Compared to the March 2026 quarter, PAT fell 72.6% QoQ from Rs. 1,114.35 Cr.

Notably, Beyond its financial performance, Suzlon reported Q1 deliveries of 506 MW, up 14% YoY, while commissioning more than doubled to 269 MW, representing 2.3x YoY growth. The company also secured 1 GW of new order additions, including two major Developer Company (DevCo)-led Engineering, Procurement and Construction ( EPC ) orders from Tata Power and Waaree Group.

As per the latest buzz, Cumulatively, Suzlon's order book stood at around 6.1 GW, with 84% of orders coming from the PSU and Commercial & Industrial (C&I) sectors. The share of EPC projects in its order book increased from 22% in Q1 FY26 to 32%, in line with its market strategy. Additionally, the company unveiled its S175 (5 MW) wind turbine platform in India and Europe and secured its first order in India. It also launched its Suzlon 2.0 strategy, built around four business verticals—RE Tech, RE DevCo , RE Projects, and RE AMS.

In further updates, Market reaction to the firm's numbers was underwhelming, in the wake of shrinkage in margins, with the stock down 6% to under Rs 50 levels after a while on a weak day for green stocks.

On top of that, On the latest announcement, Girish Tanti, Vice Chairman, Suzlon Group, shared, "Suzlon 2.0 is underway as we build 4 strategic growth engines with wind-led RE solutions, strengthen our technology, and focus on long-term customer partnerships. All new growth areas are gaining traction. The S175-5.x MW had a strong debut, and the S144-3.x MW order book is building significant momentum. During the quarter, we also deepened existing partnerships and formed new ones to accelerate our customers' energy transition journey."

Ajay Kapur, Chief Executive Officer, Suzlon Group, shared, "Our strong start to FY27 reflects disciplined execution across every aspect of our business. We achieved our highest-ever first quarter deliveries of 506 MW, up +14% y-o-у, while more than doubling our commissioning as projects moved into advanced stages of execution. With the successful launch of first FDRE-ready S175 wind turbine and manufacturing now scaled at our Bhuj facility, we are well-prepared to meet future demand."

title: Kangana Ranaut calls Cockroach Janta Party's Saurav Das ‘useless and unemployed’: At his age, I had 2 National Awards
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Kangana Ranaut fired back at Saurav Das for his comments about her. What Kangana shared Taking to her Instagram Stories, Kangana reposted a video of Saurav speaking about her, and added a note. It read, “I googled this person and he is 28 years old. How he claims to be a student I have no clue! Yes I am in politics for past 2 years but I have been in public life for the last 20 years. At his age, I had 2 National Awards.”

Adding to this, Kangana accepted her past comments as an MP and added, “Yes as a new Parlamentarian I was overwhelmed with all the work because I am also a filmmaker + performing artist + producer + screen writer + entrepreneur. But someone like him who is totally useless and unemployed will never understand what it means to be in massive demand in all times at any age.”
Meanwhile, “Dear Saurav your issues are personal. You are not a student you are simply useless. Let's start with learning some skill. It's a good place to start,” she concluded.

Notably, In conversation with ANI, Saurav had shared, "Even members of her own party don't pay much heed to Kangana Ranaut or take her seriously, so why should we? I don't think anyone in Gen Z, Gen Alpha, or any younger generation takes her seriously or listens to what she says. She is a politician now. There were videos from when she visited her constituency in Himachal Pradesh where she remarked that she had expected the job to require very little work, only to realise that being a Member of Parliament involves a massive amount of labour. That speaks volumes about her own seriousness. Gen Z has done more for this country than her.”

As per the latest buzz, This was in response to what Kangana had shared about the Gen Z protests over the last few days. Kangana wrote, “Never in my life, I have seen so much ugliness in one place. These reels from Gen Z protests are puke-inducing, the way they speak and the kind of language they are using. Never in my life have I seen everything in each and every frame so jarring and so crass all at once.”

In further updates, She added, “Ewwww, who is birthing and raising them? India is a place of diversely beautiful people, draped in elegance and rooted in cultural sophistication; you call yourselves cockroaches and look/behave like them as well; there is no paradox or juxtaposition there, just simply subjecting the world to your filth, garbage and ugliness. I am scarred from these reels, need some healing, digital detox.”

On top of that, Her remarks came after Delhi Police directed multiple social media platforms to remove posts and videos containing offensive and abusive remarks against Modi. The posts were allegedly uploaded during the student protests at Jantar Mantar after the police crackdown during the July 20 Chalo Sansad march.

title: Dev Anand's son Suneil Anand passes away at 70 after suffering heart attack in London
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Star Suneil Anand, son of legendary star Dev Anand, passed away in London at the age of 70 following a heart attack, his family verified.
Adding to this, The news of his demise was verified by the family through a statement issued by his niece, Gina Narang, who requested privacy as they mourn the loss.

Meanwhile, Sharing the news, Gina Narang shared the family is grateful for the support they have received during this difficult time: "With heavy hearts, our family mourns the passing of Suneil Anand. We are comforted by the outpouring of love, prayers, and support, for which we are truly grateful. We kindly request privacy as we navigate this difficult time together."

Notably, Suneil Anand was the only son of iconic star and filmmaker Dev Anand and his wife Kalpana Kartik. Born into one of Hindi cinema's most celebrated movie families, Suneil made his acting debut with Anand Aur Anand (1984), a movie directed by his father.
As per the latest buzz, Suneil Anand's passing marks the end of another chapter in the Anand family's cinematic legacy. Further details regarding the last rites are awaited.

In further updates, The entire team at Bollywood Hungama extends its heartfelt condolences to Suneil Anand's family, friends and loved ones during this difficult time. May his soul rest in peace, and may those mourning his loss find strength and comfort in the memories they shared with him.

title: Marvel Studios Unveils Its First-Ever Punisher Movie Poster
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Spider-Man: Brand New Day received a stunning new poster for the Chinese market that notably highlights Jon Bernthal's Punisher. This marks the Punisher's first appearance on a Marvel Studios movie poster as he makes his big-screen debut in Brand New Day , having previously only appeared in streaming projects.

Adding to this, Frank Castle's theatrical MCU debut in Brand New Day is rather fitting, as the Punisher's first comic appearance came in 1974's The Amazing Spider-Man #129. The Walking Dead alum received fifth billing for Spider-Man 4 , signaling that his role is crucial and justifying his central place on the latest poster.

Meanwhile, Bernthal donned the Punisher's iconic skull for the first time over a decade ago in Daredevil Season 2 before he received a two-season Netflix spin-off. The crime-slayer made his vengeful presence known in the MCU for 11 years in four seasons of TV and a Disney+ special, although Brand New Day will arguably put the Punisher in front of more eyes than ever before.

Notably, The Punisher received his first-ever Marvel Studios poster for Daredevil: Born Again Season 1 , in which he appeared in Episode 4, "Sic Semper Systema," and Episode 9, "Straight to Hell," to team up with the Man Without Fear. The TV-MA Disney+ series marked Frank Castle's MCU comeback after a six-year absence, following the cancellation of his solo Netflix series in 2019.

As per the latest buzz, Bernthal was absent from Born Again Season 2 and the final clash with Kingpin due to his other MCU filming commitments, including The Punisher: One Last Kill , which premiered on Disney+ in May. The sub-one-hour special may be the closest the Punisher has come to a Marvel Studios movie until now, although the character already has a storied pre-MCU theatrical legacy.

In further updates, Almost four decades ago, The Punisher marked the legendary vigilante's live-action debut in a 1989 movie starring Rocky IV star Dolph Lundgren, which was rolled out direct-to-video in the US and theatrically overseas. The movie's poster perfectly summarized the Punisher's mantra with the tagline, "Judge. Jury. Executioner. All in a day's work."

On top of that, Fifteen years later, The Punisher rebooted Frank Castle in 2004, with Thomas Jane sporting the white skull and duel-wielding pistols in badass fashion on the poster. Jane later reprised the role in 2012's The Punisher: Dirty Laundry , a fan movie short that acted as an unofficial sequel to the 2004 movie.

While Lionsgate Films was originally cooking up its own official sequel to Jane's The Punisher , it was later abandoned in favor of a reboot that cast the late Ray Stevenson as Frank Castle in Punisher: War Zone .

title: Shilpa Shetty breaks silence after reservation post goes viral: “I am shocked to see fake statements falsely attached to my name”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The star has denied any connection to the widely shared message on caste-based reservation, urging social media users not to believe fabricated claims circulating online.

Adding to this, The widely shared post, which was widely shared online, read, “Don’t touch reservation. Let general category doctors treat only general category patients and let everyone else treat only patients from their own caste. Do this for a few years and people will start asking to end caste-based reservation themselves. You can't get skill through reservation.”

Meanwhile, As the post continued to circulate with her name attached to it, Shilpa Shetty took to social media to set the record straight and distance herself from the message. The star categorically denied authoring or endorsing the statement, describing it as fabricated. Addressing the issue, Shilpa wrote, “I am shocked to see fake statements on reservation falsely attached to my name. This is completely fabricated, malicious garbage. Do not fall for this fake news.”
Notably, I am shocked to see fake statements on reservation falsely attached to my name. This is completely fabricated, malicious garbage.
As per the latest buzz, — SHILPA SHETTY KUNDRA (@TheShilpaShetty) July 28, 2026

In further updates, With this statement, the star made it clear that the widely shared message did not originate from her and urged people not to believe or further circulate misinformation carrying her name. Shilpa's response has since been widely shared online, with many users appreciating her prompt clarification while urging others to verify information before forwarding or engaging with widely shared posts.

On top of that, The clarification comes at a time when misinformation and fabricated star statements continue to spread rapidly across social media platforms, often leading to confusion among users. Public figures have increasingly had to address such instances directly to prevent false narratives from gaining credibility.

For now, Shilpa Shetty has unequivocally shared that the reservation-related message circulating online has no connection to her. Her clarification puts to rest speculation surrounding the widely shared post and reiterates her appeal to the public not to fall for fabricated statements falsely attributed to her.

Adding to this, Gold of 99.9 per cent purity jumped Rs 2,440 to Rs 1,49,640 per 10 grams (inclusive of all taxes), according to the All India Sarafa Association. The metal traded at Rs 1,47,200 per 10 grams in the previous session.
Meanwhile, Silver prices also rebounded by Rs 5,300 to Rs 2,30,000 per kg (inclusive of all taxes) from Friday’s closing level of Rs 2,24,700 per kg.

As per the latest buzz, “Gold gained on Monday as easing tensions in West Asia triggered a sharp decline in crude oil prices, easing inflation concerns, while a weak US dollar and lower Treasury bond yields provided further support for bullion,” shared Saumil Gandhi, Senior Analyst – Commodities at HDFC Securities.
In further updates, He, however, added that gains in the domestic market remained limited as the Indian rupee strengthened against the US dollar.
On top of that, In the global markets, spot gold gained USD 42.13, or 1.04 per cent, to USD 4,095.30 per ounce, while silver rose 1.47 per cent to USD 59.04 per ounce.

“Spot gold hovered near USD 4,100 per ounce on Monday, while silver extended gains to USD 59 per ounce in the international markets,” Kaynat Chainwala, AVP Commodity Research, Kotak Securities, shared.

body: Here's what's trending across India right now:
Links to the chats, some of which included personal and work information, would show up if a user of a search engine like Google used a site-specific search term.
Adding to this, The searches showed Claude chats for which a user had decided to "share" a link had been saved by search engines like Google, leaving them accessible to the broader public.
Meanwhile, The search availability of the chat logs was removed over the weekend, but many were saved and shared widely online.
Notably, A spokeswoman for Anthropic shared that Claude users maintained control over if and when to share conversations they had with the chatbot.
As per the latest buzz, She shared links to conversations were "not guessable or discoverable unless people choose to share them themselves".

In further updates, "When someone shares a conversation, they are making that content publicly accessible, and like other public web content, it may be archived by third-party services," the spokeswoman added.

On top of that, The share option within Claude tells a user that "anyone with the link" may view the contents of that link, but does not explicitly state that the link may end up in Google and search results.
Users on Reddit initially discovered the publicly available chats, which covered more than 200 conversations with Claude across at least 25 pages of search results - some taking place just weeks ago.

title: Kangana Ranaut defends those beating up students 'on the roads': Jab bolte ho toh sunna bhi padega
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star and BJP MP Kangana Ranaut has criticised the Cockroach Janta Party protests, which were predominantly attended and led by the students. She has defended those beating the protestors among the students, saying that they must know every action has an equal and opposite reaction.

Adding to this, Kangana took to her Instagram Stories and wrote: “Protestors who are getting beaten and abused on the roads by common people because of their filthy and abusive reels. They must understand that jab bolte ho toh sunna bhi padega. Agar tum public property damage karte ho toh woh public bhi tumko damage karegi. Agar tumko desh aur leadership se problem hai aur tumne publicly khoob gandi gandi gaaliyan di toh ab unki suno jo iss desh se pyaar karte hain aur iss sarkar ko vote ki power se leke aayein hain. Kyuki bolne ka haq unko bhi hain. Ab rone wali koi baat nahi. Every action has equal and opposite reaction agar padai karke cause and effect samajh nahi aya hai toh aab aa jayega. Aur bahut acche se samjh aayega.”

Meanwhile, It translates to: “You say a lot and so shall listen now. If you damage public property, then the public will damage you too. If you have a problem with the country and the leadership and abuse them badly then now listen the same from the ones who love the country and have voted for this government. They also have the power to say. Nothing to cry about. Now you will understand what it means that every action has an equal and opposite reaction.”

Notably, On Monday, Kangana had shared that the protests are in stark difference with the values and sophistication that India stands for. She shared, “Never in my life, I have seen so much ugliness in one place. These reels from Gen Z protests are puke-inducing, the way they speak and the kind of language they are using. Never in my life have I seen everything in each and every frame so jarring and so crass all at once.”

As per the latest buzz, She added, “Ewwww, who is birthing and raising them? India is a place of diversely beautiful people, draped in elegance and rooted in cultural sophistication; you call yourselves cockroaches and look/behave like them as well; there is no paradox or juxtaposition there, just simply subjecting the world to your filth, garbage and ugliness. I am scarred from these reels, need some healing, digital detox.”

In further updates, The Gen Z protests sparked a widely shared trend on Instagram with many students documenting their experience on the platform. From making fit checks before attending the protests to making memes like “Dilli Police se maar khane jaa raha hu (Going to get a beating from the Delhi Police),” the Gen Z protestors laughed and danced at the protest site as the protest itself became content. Reels also showed protesters running from police barricades set to the iconic Subway Surfers soundtrack.

On top of that, The sprawling sit-in in Delhi’s historic Jantar Mantar was called off hours after the resignation was revealed by the minister on X with leaders of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) saying the government had accepted two other demands. Celebrations erupted soon after as young men and women – many of them Gen Z -- waved the tricolour, climbed barricades and broke into impromptu jigs as makeshift loudspeakers belted out Bollywood favourites.

title: Sunny Deol tears up as Rajkumar Santoshi recalls Dharmendra’s reaction to Batwara 1947: ‘Bola tha picture chalegi’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Aamir Khan Productions’ Batwara 1947 trailer was unveiled on Tuesday in the presence of the movie's cast and crew. It also left everyone emotional as director Rajkumar Santoshi narrated late Dharmendra’s bonding with the movie. Sunny Deol , Shabana Azmi, Karan Deol and Abhimanyu Singh were in attendance at the launch of the trailer. The movie's story revolves around the chaos and mess caused during the partition of 1947, which saw many families torn apart in the madness of communal riots.

Adding to this, Sunny Deol gets emotional as Rajkumar Santoshi recalls Dharmendra’s reaction to Batwara 1947. Sunny Deol gets emotional over Dharmendra’s connection with the movie The trailer launch became particularly moving when Rajkumar spoke about Dharmendra , who had watched the movie before his death. Sunny was visibly emotional, wiping away tears as the filmmaker recalled how the veteran star reacted when he was shown the movie.

Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram Addressing the press in Hindi, Rajkumar shared, “Dharam ji ki blessing bahut hai iss movie ke andar. Narration suna tha and he was very emotional. Aankh mein aansu aa gaye, bahut aashirwad diya aur Dharam ji ki mere khyaal se last movie joh unhone dekhi woh bhi Batwara hai. Tabhi unhone bola tha ki picture bahut chalegi bahut achcha kaam kiya aap logon ne unka aashirwad hai toh I am grateful and I thank Dharam ji today here."

Notably, (Translation: This movie carries Dharam-ji's abundant blessings. When he heard the narration, he was deeply moved—he was even brought to tears—and he offered his heartfelt blessings. In fact, I believe Batwara was the last movie of mine that he watched; even back then, he predicted it would be a huge success and lauded the excellent work we had done. I am truly grateful for his blessings and wish to express my thanks to Dharam-ji here today.)

As per the latest buzz, Shabana Azmi also got emotional and opened up about one of the most difficult moments she had to movie for Batwara 1947. The veteran star plays a character who is subjected to violence and humiliation, with a scene in the trailer showing her being dragged by the antagonist as her kurta is torn.

In further updates, “There is a scene in the movie which, personally, as a human being, made me feel very humiliated and very stripped of any dignity. You see a glimpse of it in the trailer, where the villain drags me and tears my kurta. At that moment, I don't think I have ever felt so vulnerable and exposed as I did as a human being,” she shared.

On top of that, View this post on Instagram Shabana gets emotional while talking about Sunny Deol The star also spoke about another interesting incident involving Sunny and his family. Shabana shared that her last show was the theatre production of Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani with Dharmendra, and she will be back on stage, doing a play with Sunny and Karan Deol.

“My last movie to rollout in theatres was with Dharam ji, and now my next movie is with Sunny and Karan. Now I can work with Abhay too. You all should ask Bobby to get ready as well,” she joked, drawing laughter from the audience.

title: Batwara 1947 trailer: Sunny Deol will do anything to protect Shabana Azmi in film on Hindu-Muslim ties. Watch
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The official trailer of Sunny Deol 's highly anticipated Batwara 1947 is here. Set against the backdrop of the 1947 Partition, the movie tells the tale of a Muslim family in Lahore who come face-to-face with a Hindu woman refusing to leave her ancestral home.

Adding to this, Batwara 1947 trailer: Sunny Deol in a still from the movie. About the trailer The trailer begins with the good news of India getting its independence after years of struggle. Sunny Deol is then shocked to see how lives are irrevocably altered as violence, fear and forced migration tear apart communities that once lived side by side. He and his family, including wife Preity Zinta and son Karan Deol shift to Pakistan where they are alloted a new house. Ali Fazal welcomes them. But to their surprise, they find that an old Hindu woman ( Shabana Azmi ) is living there upstairs, and refuses to leave the house. She even performs puja in a small temple in her room, which angers many in the community.

Meanwhile, As tension arises with many forcing her to get out of the home, Sunny becomes a shield to keep her safe and protect his own family. When he is told why he is so desperate to save a Hindu woman, Sunny fires back: “Hindu aurat? Woh Maa hai Maa! Maa ko Hindu-Muslim mein naa baatiye. Maa apne aap mein ek mazhab hai. Har insaan ka pehla mazhab Maa hai. Har insaan ke mooh se nikla pehla labz Maa hai (Hindu woman? She is a mother. Do not label her with Hindu- Muslim. Our first religion is mother! The first word that we speak is mother).”

Notably, Batwara 1947 marks Preity's return to acting after over half a decade. The music for the movie has been composed by AR Rahman , with lyrics by Javed Akhtar. The movie has been cleared by the Central Board of Movie Certification (CBFC) without any cuts. Sunny took to his Instagram Stories to confirm the same on Monday.

As per the latest buzz, He wrote, “We're delighted that Batwara 1947 has been cleared by the CBFC without a single cut and awarded an A certificate. A movie about humanity and love. Watch it in theatres from this Partition Day, 14th August.” Batwara 1947 marks the reunion of 90's hit star-director combo-- Sunny Deol and Raj Kumar Santoshi. The pair has given iconic hits like Ghatak , Ghayal and Damini and Sunny believes the audience have been waiting for them to collaborate again.
In further updates, Batwara 1947 releases in theatres on August 14.

title: Samay Raina takes a dig at box office collection of Alia Bhatt and Sharvari's Alpha at India's Got Latent. Watch
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Comedian Samay Raina 's show, India's Got Latent Season 2 , kicked off with Alia Bhatt and Sharvari as its first guests. The two appeared on the show to promote their movie, Alpha . However, in the latest episode of India's Got Latent, Samay took a sly dig at Alpha's box-office performance.

Adding to this, Samay Raina says Alia Bhatt and Sharvari's Alpha didn't work in theatres. Samay Raina takes a dig at Alpha The latest members-only episode featured Raghav Juyal and Niharika NM on the panel, who appeared to promote their movie, Bhai Tera Star Hai. While Raghav was talking about the movie, Samay pointed out that it was the second time he had repeated its title and quipped, "kitni baar khudh hi btaana padega. Kaisa star hai tu? (How many times will you have to tell people about your own movie? What kind of star are you?)"
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Bollywood Netra (@bollywoodnetra)

Notably, In response, Raghav shared, "Alia Bhatt ne bhi khudh hi btaya tha (Alia Bhatt also promoted her own movie)." Samay then replied, "Uski bhi nahi chali fir (That didn't work for her movie either)."

As per the latest buzz, Samay had also booked an entire theatre to watch Alpha and distributed tickets to followers. Later, after the screening ended, he video-called Alia and told her that the audience had enjoyed the movie.

In further updates, Alpha underperformed at the ticket-window, collecting ₹ 98.83 crore rupees worldwide and ₹ 58.62 crore rupees in India. Helmed by Aditya Rawal, Alpha is the YRF Spy Universe's first female-led movie. It stars Alia Bhatt, Sharvari, Anil Kapoor and Bobby Deol in lead roles. The movie follows two elite agents on a high-stakes mission involving national security, blending large-scale action sequences with espionage.

On top of that, The movie opened to mixed-to-negative reviews from both critics and audiences. It also features a cameo by Hrithik Roshan, which received a mixed response. While some viewers called it the best part of the movie, others felt it was unnecessary. Alia and Sharvari's performances also received criticism. Alpha is the seventh instalment in the YRF Spy Universe after Ek Tha Tiger, Tiger Zinda Hai, War, Pathaan, Tiger 3 and War 2. Apart from Alpha, the franchise has enjoyed a successful run at the ticket-window.

India's Got Latent became embroiled in row after Ranveer Allahbadia's remarks about parents and sex sparked widespread backlash on social media. title: DA hike: Inflation-linked wage, DA merger, new formula—here are Dearness Allowance-related demands of employee groups
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

More than one crore rupees beneficiaries — about 50 lakh central government employees and nearly 65 lakh retired central government pensioners — benefit from the Centre's DA hike announcements. ( Bloomberg / Representative Image ) AI Quick Read A significant number of India's public service employees are set to benefit from their various state governments' announcements on Dearness Allowance (DA) hikes. The Centre hiked DA by 2% in April, from 58% of basic pay to 60%, effective from 1 January this year.

Adding to this, The Centre usually updates DA biannually using data from the All-India Consumer Price Index ( AICPI ), new announcements are made in March and October, with rollouts in January and July. The move is aimed at countering the increasing cost of living expenses for employees and pensioners amid rising inflation.

Meanwhile, More than one crore rupees beneficiaries — about 50 lakh central government employees and nearly 65 lakh central government pensioners , including defence personnel and retirees, will benefit from the Centre's DA hike announcements across 18 employee levels.

Notably, Today, we take a look at some of the DA demands made by representative groups, unions and stakeholders who collectively represent a large number of employees and pensioners, including defence and railway staff.

As per the latest buzz, Submissions made by these groups are expected to play an important role in shaping the 8th pay commission's final recommendations. Notably, the 8th CPC closed the memorandum submission window last month on 15 June, while submissions for data will close on 31 July. It has, in the meantime, scheduled meetings in Delhi, Chennai and Puducherry to facilitate stakeholder discussions.

In further updates, Notably, the government has not officially revealed a DA merger as of July 2026, but the issue has gained traction because basic salary determines other components of compensation i.e. provident fund contribution, pension, allowances, gratuity, and more. Thus, higher DA and, by association, basic pay mean an increase in overall salary and linked allowances.

On top of that, The federation has suggested that the DA calculation formula must reflect relatively higher inflation on personal items and has called for a complete overhaul of the index, replacing it with an employee-specific cost-of-living index.

Notably, after the Centre's announcement came increases by the Indian Banks' Association ( IBA ) — which hiked basic salaries between ₹ 48,000 and ₹ 1,17,000 and DA from ₹ 435 to ₹ 1,050 for workmen and officer employees across levels for May, June and July 2026; and the Indian Railways — which hiked DA by 2%.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mil Gaya".

Notably, "'Umrao Jaan' has never left me. She lives in my memories, in my silences, and in the hearts of those who have embraced her with a lot of love over the years. I accept this honour with immense gratitude, not only as a recognition of my own journey, but also as a tribute to the filmmakers, writers, musicians and countless collaborators who have enriched my life and shaped my work."

"There are very few artists whose presence transcends cinema and becomes part of a nation's cultural consciousness. Rekha ji is one such timeless icon. Her extraordinary body of work, her grace, and the unparalleled legacy she has built over decades have inspired audiences not only in India but across the world. It is an immense privilege for the Indian Movie Festival of Melbourne to welcome her as our Guest of Honour this year," Mitu Bhowmick Lange, Founder and Festival Director of the Indian Movie Festival of Melbourne, shared.

title: ‘They are so ugly’: Kangana Ranaut says some young Hindu women are ‘generation gutter’ in fresh IG rant
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Kangana Ranaut has once again stirred up row on social media. On Monday evening, the star-turned-politician shared a message on her Instagram Story, criticising a certain trend of “westernised Indian women.” It comes days after she commented on the so-called Gen Z protest reels that went widely shared on social media after the NEET exam paper leak incident. Her latest message addressed primarily the young Hindu women who, according to her, are “demanding” more rights without taking responsibility for their actions.

Adding to this, Kangana Ranaut says some young Hindu women flaunt freedom without accountability, calls them ‘generation gutter’. (Naveen Sharma) What Kangana wrote Taking to her Instagram story, Kangana wrote, “Most appalling is the behaviour of young Hindu women, who want to imitate the lives of independent career women. without earning that freedom.”

Meanwhile, She went on to praise women who are financially and personally independent, saying, “women who are truly independent they make rebellious choices. Bold opinions. Unconventional career moves and they take accountability for their actions. They have to cos they are on their own. They don’t do this at the cost of their parents or families.”
Notably, She referred to some women as “generation gutter.” She wrote, “Here is a new generation of so called westernised Indian women. I call them generation gutter.”

As per the latest buzz, Kangana further added, “Some of them have nothing to offer to the system they are not good at studies but they are so ugly and corrupt that they can’t be home makers either but they proudly flaunt their freedom to have drugs, drinks or endless body counts and shamelessly live off their patents earnings and constantly fight to live independent lives without actually being independent.”

In further updates, She ended the note with a “gentle reminder,” writing, "Independent life needs to be collected. If you try to live independent without accountability you are just a distorted entity. Gutter chap.”

On top of that, This is not the first time in recent days that Kangana has spoken about young people. After videos from the NEET-related protests went widely shared, she shared the clips made her feel she needed “some healing” and a “digital detox.” Those remarks also generated considerable discussion online. “You call yourself cockroaches and look/behave like them as well... there is no paradox or juxtaposition there, just simply subjecting the world to your filth, garbage and ugliness. I am scarred from these reels, need some healing, digital detox,” the star had shared.

Professionally, Kangana Ranaut’s latest venture has been the movie Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata , directed by Manoj Tapadia, based on the true story of the nurses and staff at Cama Hospital who saved the lives of patients during the 2008 Mumbai terrorist attacks.

Adding to this, Madhya Pradesh's off-spinner Saransh Jain was the lone surprise pick in India's 15-member squad for the soon-to-release two-Test series in Sri Lanka next month. The 33-year-old off-spinner was drafted into the Test squad as a replacement for the injured Washington Sundar.

Meanwhile, Madhya Pradesh's Jain came into the reckoning after his impressive all-round performances for India A in Sri Lanka earlier this month. In the second match against Sri Lanka A in Galle, the off-spinner bagged six wickets in the two innings, while scoring a handy 70 not out at No 7 to play a key role in India A's 10-wicket victory.

Notably, Jain, who bowls off-spin and bats left-handed, was preferred over Harsh Dubey with India already boasting of three left-arm spinners in the 15-member squad in Ravindra Jadeja, Kuldeep Yadav and Manav Suthar.
As per the latest buzz, The spinner was rewarded for his consistent performances for Madhya Pradesh in Ranji Trophy. He has claimed 78 wickets in 22 games in the last three seasons of Ranji Trophy.

In further updates, He has also excelled with the bat for Madhya Pradesh. In the Ranji Trophy last season, he was MP's highest run-getter with 518 runs in seven games at an average of 57.55, with a century and three fifties, while in the 2023-24 season he amassed 432 runs in eight games with a century and a fifty.

On top of that, In the 2025-26 Duleep Trophy, playing for Central Zone, Jain was the highest wicket-taker with 16 wickets from two games, while scoring fifties in the semi-final against West Zone and in the final against South Zone in Bengaluru in September last year.

Overall, he has played 54 first class games in which he has taken 188 wickets at an average of 27.30, while scoring 2223 runs with two centuries and 14 fifties. He was also part of a specialised training camp for emerging off-spinners under Harbhajan Singh at the BCCI Centre of Excellence in Bengaluru in March.

title: Bank of Baroda’s FCNR(B) inflows to replace Rs 18,000 crore of bulk deposits, says MD Debadatta Chand
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Second largest public sector lender Bank of Baroda expects to replace nearly Rs 17,000-18,000 crore rupees of bulk deposits through mobilisation of Foreign Currency Non-Resident (Bank) [FCNR(B)] deposits under the Reserve Bank of India's swap window, with the lender targeting USD 4-5 billion of overseas fundraising across FCNR(B), Medium Term Notes (MTNs) and Overseas Foreign Currency Borrowings (OFCBs). The bank has already mobilised close to USD 700 million through FCNR(B) deposits and expects to cross the USD 1 billion mark by the end of July, with at least USD 2 billion of the overall target expected to come from FCNR(B) deposits alone, Managing Director & CEO Debadatta Chand shared. Advt "We anticipated that we'll be raising something around USD 4 to 5 billion in terms of all the three instruments, FCNR, MTN, and also on the OFCB. As of today on FCNR, we have raised almost close to USD 700 million now. Possibly by month end, we'll be crossing USD 1 billion. In that way, we're quite hopeful of our initial target of raising roughly around USD 4 to 5 billion on the time the window closes," Chand shared. The FCNR(B) mobilisation comes as banks seek to diversify funding sources and reduce dependence on wholesale deposits after the RBI revealed a temporary swap facility to attract foreign currency deposits . According to Chand, the expected FCNR(B) inflows would directly substitute a sizeable portion of the bank's bulk deposits. "We're expecting at least minimum USD 2 billion out of FCNR(B). To the extent of, let's say, Rs 17,000-18,000 crore rupees of positive effect it is going to have on the bulk deposit," he shared. Executive Director Lalit Tyagi shared the bank has already operationalised loans against FCNR(B) deposits for eligible NRIs to improve participation. Chand shared Bank of Baroda has spent the last several years consciously reducing its dependence on wholesale deposits while strengthening granular deposits. Advt As of June 30, 2026, bulk deposits (including certificates of deposit) stood at Rs 3.18 lakh crore rupees, marginally lower than Rs 3.19 lakh crore rupees in March 2026 despite rising 37 per cent year-on-year. Domestic deposits grew 14.7 per cent YoY to Rs 13.82 lakh crore rupees, while global deposits increased 13.8 per cent to Rs 16.34 lakh crore rupees. Retail term deposits rose 8.8 per cent to Rs 5.43 lakh crore rupees, although the domestic CASA ratio moderated to 37.72 per cent from 38.90 per cent in March. Overseas franchise Chand shared Bank of Baroda is underwriting nearly USD 1.5 billion of external commercial borrowings (ECBs) that will eventually flow into India under the RBI's swap framework. Advt "We have almost like in a process of almost giving up to USD 1.5 billion in terms of ECB by tapping resources across the globe, entirely done by Bank of Baroda in terms of underwriting those ECBs. That's the money going to come to India, and our overseas branches are in a position to fund those ECBs for the public sector undertakings as part of the swap window. That again can upsize my targeted USD 4 to 5 billion inflow that can happen to India through Bank of Baroda channels," he shared. The lender also plans to deepen its international footprint as overseas operations continue to outpace domestic growth. Advt "The bank in the last five years has been a success story in terms of repositioning our overseas presence, both in terms of branch networking and also the business there. The growth of overseas would have seen it is growing almost like 15 to 20 percent for last many quarters. There are significant opportunities. We are a big player now in the global syndication market across the globe," Chand shared. He added that the bank intends to increase overseas business as a share of its global book over the next few years. "The overseas book as a percentage of global book is almost like 16-17 percent now. In the foreseeable future, subject to global markets remaining in good shape, I think we can increase it up to 19-20 percent in a couple of years now," he shared. Without naming countries, Chand verified that multiple overseas geographies are under evaluation. "Multiple geographies are under consideration. We cannot outline them at this point of time, but it can be any geography where it makes strategic sense for Bank of Baroda and for the country also to have a presence because India is signing a lot of FTAs now. We are there to capture both the trade flows vis-à-vis India and overseas, and also the capital flow," he shared. The international expansion strategy builds on the bank's already growing overseas business. During the June quarter, international advances increased 23.3 per cent year-on-year to Rs 2.66 lakh crore rupees, while international deposits rose 8.9 per cent to Rs 2.52 lakh crore rupees, contributing to global business of Rs 30.5 lakh crore rupees, up 15.4 per cent from a year earlier.

title: Priyanka Chopra gets emotional as daughter Malti vibes to her song Tune Maari Entriyaan: 'Who would've thought?'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Priyanka Chopra arrived in India on Sunday afternoon with her husband, singer Nick Jonas, and their daughter, Malti Marie . The Jonas family is currently staying in Hyderabad, leaving followers wondering whether Priyanka has returned to the country to resume the shoot of SS Rajamouli 's Varanasi. On Monday, Priyanka gave a glimpse into Malti's day in Hyderabad, where the little one was seen vibing to her mother's song.

Adding to this, Priyanka Chopra's daughter watches her song from Gunday. Malti Marie watches mom Priyanka Chopra's song On Monday, Priyanka Chopra posted on Instagram to share a heartwarming glimpse of her daughter, Malti Marie. In the picture, Malti was seen sitting on a couch, engrossed in the television. But instead of watching cartoons, she was watching her mother on screen. Priyanka's hit song Tune Maari Entriyaan from Gunday was playing on the television, and Malti appeared to be admiring her mother while happily vibing to the track.

Meanwhile, Sharing the adorable moment, Priyanka also tagged her husband, Nick Jonas, seemingly suggesting that he too was watching the song with Malti. She captioned the post, "Who would have thought," along with a crying face and red heart emoji. In another photo, Priyanka shared a sweet moment between Malti and her grandmother, Madhu Chopra. The grandmother-granddaughter duo was seen walking together on a terrace, enjoying some quality time.

Notably, Followers reacted to the post, with one writing, "She must be absolutely amazed and proud." Another commented, "Malti is vibing." Another wrote, "So cute." Another commented, "Wow, it's so beautiful." One fan also requested, "Please do Malti's reaction while watching you."

As per the latest buzz, Gunday is a 2014 action drama directed by Ali Abbas Zafar. Starring Ranveer Singh, Arjun Kapoor and Priyanka Chopra Jonas, the movie follows the story of two orphaned friends who rise from being coal smugglers to becoming powerful figures in Kolkata, only to find their bond tested by love and rivalry. The movie was a commercial success. The song Tune Maari Entriyaan was sung by Bappi Lahiri, KK, Neeti Mohan and Vishal Dadlani. It was composed by Sohail Sen, with lyrics by Irshad Kamil, and went on to become a chartbuster.

In further updates, Priyanka will make her return to Indian cinema with SS Rajamouli's Varanasi. The action-adventure movie, which also incorporates elements of time travel, stars Mahesh Babu and Prithviraj Sukumaran in lead roles. Mounted on a budget of ₹ 1,000 crore rupees, it is one of the most expensive films in Indian cinema.

On top of that, Priyanka essays the role of Mandakini in the movie. The first-look poster showed her fighting goons with guns while wearing a saree. The project marks her return to Indian cinema after an eight-year hiatus, and followers are eagerly awaiting her on-screen chemistry with Mahesh Babu. Varanasi is currently under production and is scheduled to rollout in theatres in April 2027.

title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender review – engaging TV-to-movie adventure
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Prefer the Guardian on Google A vatar just can’t catch a break at the movies. Not the blue-cat-people franchise that makes at least a billion dollars each time, mind you – though that mega-successful series is part of what vexes big-screen versions of Avatar: The Last Airbender, a Nickelodeon animated series that predates the rollout of the similar-named, different-premised James Cameron movie. Following the anime-inspired, fan-beloved show’s three-season run on cable, the material was adapted into a live-action feature, The Last Airbender, by no less than M Night Shyamalan, rolled out six months after Cameron’s megahit. The Last Airbender was a decent-sized hit, but loathed by followers and critics alike – even today’s crop of Shyamalan boosters can’t find much positive to say about it – and failed to kickstart the hoped-for live-action movie series. (Netflix has since made an unrelated live-action adaptation as a TV show .)

Adding to this, Read more More of late, Paramount opened up that an animated sequel movie, Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender, following the characters years after the events of the series, would arrive in movie theaters – only to delay the rollout and eventually backtrack its theatrical status, turning it into a direct-to-streaming movie. The movie was then leaked online, well ahead of its debut. Now it’s getting a token two-city theatrical rollout, simultaneously with its debut on Paramount+, to make sure it qualifies for this year’s Oscars. Given the franchise’s cinematic luck so far, the movie-makers may not need to clear shelf space quite yet.

Meanwhile, But that’s nothing to do with the quality of the movie itself, which very much deserves a wider theatrical berth than it’s getting, and will probably look more impressive than at least a couple of this year’s eventual best animated feature nominees. Avatar: The Last Airbender was always a good-looking show, its Japanese-influenced animation bound only by TV budgets, but Avatar Aang takes its action-fantasy design further, with old-fashioned hand-drawn characters augmented by gorgeous computer-animated environments and backgrounds. Its colorful, kinetic style is so naturally appealing that animation followers may want to check it out even if they don’t know much about the source material.

Notably, Should that audience dip into Avatar Aang, they shouldn’t be too lost. As with a lot of TV-to-movie adaptations, the movie seems more or less comprehensible to newbies, quickly explaining that the young adult Aang (Eric Nam) belongs to a near-extinct lineage of “airbenders” in a world where other super-powered tribes can control water, fire and earth. Aang, as established in the series and reiterated here, is also the legendary chosen “avatar” able to command all four elements. Since halting a century-long war at the end of the series, Aang has stayed with his childhood sweetheart Katara (Jessica Matten) as they attempt to rebuild the world in greater harmony. The movie reunites the now-grown Aang and Katara with their longtime pals Toph (Dionne Quan), an earthbender; Zuko (Steven Yeun), a firebender; and Katara’s goofy, non-bending brother Sokka (Román Zaragoza) to find an ancient artefact before the less peace-minded group known as The Denied can claim it as their own. Along the way, they unexpectedly encounter Tagah (Dave Bautista), another airbender who was frozen for years, as Aang was at the start of the series.

As per the latest buzz, None of this is as hard to follow as it might sound. Whether it will fully resonate with non-followers on an emotional level is another question – and maybe beside the point, given that this is a direct sequel to a three-season TV series (and, for that matter, the characters are all pretty immediately likable). The more pressing matter is whether the movie’s relative accessibility as a reintroduction will render it less satisfying to those who know and love these characters.

In further updates, Here, too, Avatar Aang deals with pretty typical TV-to-movie translation: all of the major beloved characters are present and accounted for (as are a handful of much smaller but equally delightful bit players), but don’t always feel as if they’re getting their due from a movie that has to focus on the relationship between Aang and his new possible ally Tagah. Worse, Tagah’s character arc will be painfully familiar not to just Avatar viewers, but anyone who has watched a movie where a mysterious new character is introduced and appears to serve as the lead’s mentor. Where could this possibly be leading?

On top of that, Well, mainly to plenty of well-staged action sequences, which may be a secondary concern for anyone who has followed these characters through 61 previous episodes. But there’s an inherent and refreshing novelty to simply revisiting this friend group having aged up another decade or so, and the theater-worthy animation provides any additional glow-up missing from the good-enough story. Though TV seems like a natural fit to continue following Aang and the rest, the prospect of a Star Trek-like movie series, where more ambitious Avatar-related stories can be told on a larger canvas, remains a tantalizing one. If Avatar Aang is meant to serve as a proof of concept that this world can work on the big screen, consider that mission finally accomplished.
Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender is out in select cinemas on 24 July and on Paramount+ on 25 July

title: Ebola Case in DRC, Uganda, and Kenya Escalating Rapidly, Responses Hampered by USAID Cuts (Foreign Policy Brief #229)
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Before its dissolution, the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID) was a leading star in combating Ebola outbreaks globally. The agency established a robust infrastructure in nations such as Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and Kenya after the deadly Ebola outbreak in 2014, in which the United States took a forefront role in responding. Paired with material and informational support from agencies such as the World Health Organization (WHO), the Center for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), and local ministries of health, USAID was able to coordinate preventative measures to curb the spread of Ebola by 80%. In February 2025, the agency experienced major funding cuts directed by the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) and eventually, a total dismantling of the agency as a whole. The ramifications of this decision is evident from the stark contrast between the response of the 2014 Ebola outbreak to the current Ebola outbreak today. As of July 11, there have been 2000 verified cases and over 700 deaths. Experts warn that this could be the fast-growing and deadliest outbreak of Ebola on record, highlighting that the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, has no treatments or vaccines.

Adding to this, It is a common misconception that the only beneficiaries of USAID are people overseas. However, this isn’t exactly the case. After World War II, development aid became a primary instrument of foreign policy. It forged diplomatic relationships between the United States and countries like Germany and Italy after the war, operating as a vehicle for the United States to exert soft power on the global stage.

Meanwhile, In many ways, USAID has also protected US national security. Take the ebola outbreak and vaccine diplomacy for example. For years, USAID’s investments in health infrastructure and vaccine distribution strengthened relationships with allies critical to maintaining a competitive edge with rival countries such as China. With the dismantling of USAID, China has stepped in as a major donor and health knowledge producer, soliciting global influence and forming partnerships with countries who have historically received aid from the United States. Cambodia and Nepal turned towards partnerships with China to fill the aid gap left from the dismantling of USAID. As Ebola continues to ravage a region already experiencing a multitude of social, political, and economic turmoil, USAID’s dissolution leaves in its place a leadership vacuum that China is well equipped to step into.

Notably, That being shared, the dismantling of USAID should not solely be viewed through a foreign policy lens. On a humanitarian level, the dismantling of USAID had harrowing consequences. According to models from Boston University epidemiologist Brooke Nicholsmore, the absence of USAID has resulted in more than 762,000 deaths including more than 500,000 children deaths worldwide. It is predicted for this toll to rise as the Ebola outbreak strikes African countries already vulnerable from social, political, and economic turmoil. and Chikwe Ihekweazu, executive director of the WHO Health Emergencies Programme, warns that actual numbers can be double or four times the number of verified cases. To escalate matters, doctors and healthcare workers in the DRC threatened to go on strike this week as their labor remains unpaid and numbers of healthcare worker deaths rise.

As per the latest buzz, Despite the pullout of USAID from countries in Africa, there are still a multitude of organizations working to combat the disease. International humanitarian NGOs such as the International Rescue Committee and Doctors Without Borders are responding to the rising Ebola cases through measures like providing disease prevention training to local healthcare workers and operating treatment centers. However, they face many hurdles in delivering adequate responses. As of right now, armed conflict between the DRC and the Rwandan-backed militia group, M23, is escalating. This poses a threat to DRC’s already insecure health infrastructure and its healthcare worker’s mobility. It also increases displacement numbers, making it harder to identify and isolate cases. Local health systems also lack the health infrastructure needed to safely conduct tests. To help and support these organizations, you can donate directly on their websites at rescue.org or doctorswithoutborders.org . Although there is no vaccine or cure for the virus, there are a couple of preventative measures you can take if you find yourself travelling to the region inflicted by the virus. The strain of the Ebola virus is spread by contact with blood or bodily fluids from a person or animal infected with the virus. It can also be spread through contaminated objects such as clothing, needles, and bedding. Avoid contact with anybody and anywhere that has been exposed to the virus. You can learn more about the Ebola virus on the CDC’s website to remain vigilant in the case that you find yourself exposed to the disease.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Scene Censored in India — and It Could Be a Spoiler
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:
Spider-Man: Brand New Day is censored in India, and it may relate to a scene that suggests a spoiler.
Adding to this, Warning! Potential Spider-Man: Brand New Day spoilers are ahead.
Meanwhile, As reported by Bollywood Hungama , Spider-Man: Brand New Day has an eight-second kiss and some swear words that have been completely cut out in India.

Notably, Some are taking this to suggest that Tom Holland's Spider-Man and Zendaya's MJ eventually rekindle their romance after Doctor Strange's spell in Spider-Man: No Way Home made everyone forget Peter Parker. But others have suggested the kiss may be between MJ and her new boyfriend, played by star Eman Esfandi, which an already depressed Peter Parker may be forced to witness (there is much speculation about the identify of Esdandi's character in Brand New Day ).

As per the latest buzz, It's unclear which characters will be doing the kissing then, but this isn't the first time India has censored a kissing scene in an otherwise unproblematic movie. James Gunn's Superman had its famous mid-air kissing scene stripped from its rollout in India for being “overly sensual." The 33-second sequence featured Superman and Lois Lane solidifying their love with an extended smooch as they slowly began to float and twirl through the air.

In further updates, Oppenheimer was also censored in India and the Middle East, though in a more comical way. At one point in the movie, Oppenheimer and Jean Tatlock (played by Florence Pugh) have an extended conversation without any clothes on. In most regions, viewers can see Pugh's nude body, but in some regions, a black dress was CGI-ed onto her body to cover her up.

On top of that, These examples of censorship have often sparked backlash, with some feeling it's an extreme reaction, particularly in the case of Superman. It's unclear why the kissing scene from Spider-Man: Brand New Day was censored, but if the Superman censorship is anything to go by, it might not even be that spicy.

Spider-Man as a franchise is no stranger to intense make-out sessions, though. In Sam Raimi's first Spider-Man movie, Mary-Jane Watson and Spider-Man share a passionate upside-down kiss during a thunderous rainstorm, leading to one of the most iconic kisses in movie history. It's hard to imagine Brand New Day topping that, but maybe they pulled it off.

title: Kuch Kuch Hota Hai child star Sana Saeed reveals she battled Bulimia: “For six years I had no name for what I was going through”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Sana Saeed opened up about silently battling Bulimia for years, revealing it took four years to recover after finally understanding her condition.

Adding to this, In a recent conversation with Hindustan Times, Sana shared that she spent six years without understanding what she was experiencing, and it took another four years after her diagnosis to fully recover.

Meanwhile, Speaking about her journey, Sana admitted that she carried a great deal of shame because she believed she was the only person facing such struggles: "For six years I had no name for what I was going through."

Notably, She explained that not knowing what she was dealing with made the experience even more isolating. Recalling the turning point in her recovery, Sana shared: "I was desperate to get better and find a healthy way to eat, and eventually I came across a book on recovery that gave me the language for what I was actually dealing with."
As per the latest buzz, The star added that it took her four years to fully recover from Bulimia.

In further updates, Sana shared she decided to speak publicly only after reaching a place of healing, hoping her story could help others going through similar experiences: "Now that I'm healed, it matters to me deeply that if my story helps even one person feel less alone in theirs, that's worth more than the discomfort of being vulnerable in public."

On top of that, The Student of the Year star also reflected on the pressure surrounding appearance in the entertainment industry. She recalled that conversations during her college years often revolved around dieting and losing weight.

Speaking about the impact of working in front of the camera, Sana shared constant scrutiny over appearance can complicate a person's relationship with their body: "Being on camera, being commented on, having your appearance be part of the job description."

title: Prime Video India partners with CJ ENM to bring over 100 Korean titles; details inside!
body: Here's the latest on what's streaming and coming up:
Prime Video India has partnered with CJ ENM to bring over 100 Korean titles, including 26 new releases, to Indian audiences over the next two years.

Adding to this, The agreement builds on the existing global partnership between Prime Video and CJ ENM, with a stronger focus on Indian audiences. The soon-to-release titles will be available with English subtitles as well as Hindi, Tamil and Telugu dubs.

Meanwhile, The slate will begin with Yumi's Cells Season Three and will also include soon-to-release series such as The Legend of Kitchen Soldier, My Bias, My Boss and Filing for Love. In addition, viewers will get access to several existing CJ ENM titles, including Dear X, Law in the City, Study Group, My Dearest Nemesis, Search: WWW, and the first two seasons of Yumi's Cells.
Notably, The collection features a mix of romance, thriller, fantasy, drama and action, with actors including Kim You-jung, Lee Jong-suk, Park Ji-hoon and Cha Woo-min.

As per the latest buzz, Speaking about the partnership, Shilangi Mukherji, Director and Head of SVOD Business at Prime Video India, shared the collaboration reflects the increasing popularity of Korean stories among Indian audiences: "Building on our strong global relationship with CJ ENM and the deal revealed last year, we're excited to deepen this collaboration with a sharper focus on India. The popularity of Korean content has been remarkable across our Prime Video markets. Compelling narratives, diverse genres, and memorable characters that transcend borders have fueled a K-content wave that continues to gain momentum year on year. By bringing a curated slate of premium Korean titles to Prime Video, we're doubling down on our commitment to making the most innovative and captivating stories from Korea accessible to audiences in India."

In further updates, Manish Menghani, Director and Head of Content Licensing at Prime Video India, shared the partnership is driven by audience preferences: "At Prime Video India, we keep a keen eye on what our customers are watching and what stories resonate with them. The surge in popularity of K-content is undeniable. CJ ENM is one of the biggest entertainment studios in Korea, with an expansive library of much-loved titles. The continued success of our global content deal with CJ ENM is a testament to this growing demand. For us, this deal is not only the natural step forward, backed by customer preferences, but also a reflection of commitment to making Prime Video India the go-to destination for the best international content."

On top of that, Jangho Seo, Executive Vice President of Platform Division at CJ ENM, shared the company sees India as an important market for expanding the reach of Korean storytelling: "We are pleased to collaborate with Prime Video India to bring CJ ENM's acclaimed K-dramas to a wider audience in one of the world's most dynamic entertainment markets. Prime Video's unmatched reach in India, combined with its deep investment in local audiences, makes it the ideal partner to amplify our content to millions of new viewers. This partnership reflects our ongoing commitment to expanding the global reach of Korean storytelling."
The new titles will be available to Prime members in India at no additional cost as part of their subscription.

title: Why Mali’s northern conflict has entered a dangerous new phase
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

x whatsapp-stroke copylink google Add Al Jazeera on Google info Azawad Liberation Front (FLA) fighters display the group's flags in Tabarachat, northern Mali [Photo: Courtesy of the Azawad Liberation Front (FLA)] By Ousmane Alsharif Published On 27 Jul 2026 27 Jul 2026 Bamako, Mali – An unprecedented battlefield partnership between a separatist movement and an al-Qaeda affiliate has transformed the conflict in northern Mali, shifting the military balance and deepening divisions over how, if at all, the war can end.
Adding to this, When the Azawad Liberation Front (FLA) and Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) launched a joint offensive on April 25, 2026, the conflict entered a phase unlike any before.

Meanwhile, A war that had long pitted the Malian state against multiple armed groups gave way to a coordinated campaign stretching from Kidal and Anefis to Tilemsi, Gao and Sevare, posing the most serious challenge to the Malian army in years and to Russia’s Africa Corps, the Kremlin-backed force that replaced the Wagner Group in Mali.
Notably, Since then, the fighting has been marked by simultaneous assaults, ambushes, drone strikes and attacks on military convoys, with all sides claiming significant battlefield gains.
As per the latest buzz, Bamako says it is working to restore state authority and dismantle what it calls a “terrorist alliance” between the FLA and JNIM.

In further updates, The FLA says it remains committed to independence for Azawad, the name separatists use for northern Mali, while JNIM portrays the war as part of a campaign to “liberate” Mali and overthrow the government, which it accuses of relying on Russian forces.
On top of that, More significant than the offensive itself, however, is the unprecedented military cooperation between a nationalist separatist movement and an al-Qaeda affiliate.
Their political ambitions remain fundamentally different, yet their cooperation has already reshaped the conflict and could have far-reaching implications for security across the Sahel.

title: Delhi High Court orders removal of Kala Hiran teaser linked to Salman Khan; says reputation must be protected
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Justice Jyoti Singh shared that if the producer failed to remove the teaser, platforms such as X and YouTube would be directed to take down the links.

Adding to this, The matter arose from Salman Khan's plea seeking protection of his personality rights. The star had earlier secured directions from the court protecting those rights and later moved an application seeking a ban on Kala Hiran , claiming it was based on the pending blackbuck poaching case.

Meanwhile, According to Khan, the movie portrays him as having links to the underworld and contains defamatory material that infringes upon his personality rights. He also argued that the project could affect his right to a fair trial, as proceedings in the alleged blackbuck hunting case are still pending before the Rajasthan High Court and the Supreme Court.

Notably, The plea further shared that the movie's poster features a character closely resembling Khan, complete with a bracelet commonly associated with the star. It also referred to media reports and statements made by producer Amit Jani, claiming they clearly indicate that the movie is based on the sub judice case.

As per the latest buzz, The petition also claimed that after Khan sent a legal notice to the filmmakers, Amit Jani publicly tore it up during an interview and later alleged on social media that he was being threatened by the star and the underworld.
In further updates, During the hearing, Justice Singh strongly criticised the producer's conduct, observing that the teaser continued to damage the star's reputation every moment it remained online.

On top of that, The court also remarked that such treatment would be unacceptable even if it involved an ordinary citizen, stressing that a person's reputation takes years to build but can be lost very quickly.

Appearing for the producer, counsel argued that the teaser never names Salman Khan and does not use artificial intelligence or deepfake technology. It was also submitted that the teaser merely depicts public events and that there is no exclusive legal protection preventing such portrayals.

title: Exclusive| Adil Hussain: My nieces are stuck in Assam's flood at Sivasagar
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Adil Hussain, born and brought up in Assam expresses anger and frustration at the current situation where his home state is dealing with floods. He says, "I've been witnessing devastating floods every year since childhood and this year it's even more. I feel terribly frustrated, angry, sad and depressed because the floods is a recurring problem and the authorities since the time I grew up in Assam haven't been able to manage the situation. Unplanned townships have grown, marshlands have been filled with industries and trees have been cut. There's been no investigation on how to resolve the issue so people in flood affected areas can be taken care of by reducing their misery." He adds that he has been trying to help his family stuck in the floods. He says, "My sister's daughters, my nieces and their respective husbands have their houses filled with water in Upper Assam's Sivasagar. I've been trying to find a way to help them and the situation is terrible." He adds that he has been in constant touch with singer Papon who is also trying to help those dealing with the situation.
Adding to this, Adil Hussain View this post on Instagram A post shared by HT City (@htcity)

Meanwhile, He says the need of the hour is a comprehensive flood management plan. "Indian scientists are sending satellites to the moon and so many countries have tackled the flood situation. Netherlands has reclaimed land from the sea. I cannot understand how government after government cannot find an expert committee- engineers, landspace planners, city planners—to come together and solve the problem." He adds that he has been trying to amplify the situation through social media and urges everyone to contribute to help Assam.

title: Exclusive| For six years I had no name for what I was going through: Sana Saeed on battling bulimia
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Sana Saeed moved from Mumbai to Los Angeles, US permanently in 2021, after previously visiting for short stints and a movie workshop at the New York Movie Academy in 2016. Still remembered as the young Anjali from Kuch Kuch Hota Hai (1998) and later for Student of the Year (2012), Sana now runs her own production company in the US with husband Csaba Wagner.

Adding to this, Sana Saeed Speaking about starting life from scratch in the US the star says, “I first came to Los Angeles to study acting and filmmaking in 2016. When I went home, I couldn’t name it yet, but I knew I had to return. I was being called to it. I’d lived my whole life in India up to that point and I think my soul just wanted a new adventure. Leaving my friends and family was harder than I expected. I knew the move would affect my work and I’d made peace with that going in. Starting over somewhere nobody knows your history is humbling, but it also cleared space for me to decide who I actually wanted to be.”

Meanwhile, The star says that having her husband by her side made the life altering decision more comforting. She says, “My husband had already been living here for a while by the time I made the move. Our production company, Beyond Magic Studios, is new and it’s something we’ve built together and we’re genuinely excited about it. We’ve come to believe, in our own ways, that going after what you want and taking risks, is the only way we want to live. I’m married to my best friend and now I get to work with him on the very thing I’ve loved my whole life. Things really do have a way of working out.”
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by HT City (@htcity)

As per the latest buzz, Sana also of late took to social media to open up about battling Bulimia (an eating disorder). She says growing up, she never heard the words bulimia or eating disorder. She says, “What it looked like to me was a bad habit I’d developed, something I had to figure out alone. I carried so much shame around it, thinking I was the only one dealing with this. For six years I had no name for what I was going through. I was desperate to get better and find a healthy way to eat and eventually I came across a book on recovery that gave me the language for what I was actually dealing with. That’s when the real healing began, and it took four years to recover completely.” She says the recovery could have started much earlier if she was aware what she was going through. “Now that I’m healed, it matters to me deeply that if my story helps even one person feel less alone in theirs, that’s worth more than the discomfort of being vulnerable in public,” says Sana.

In further updates, She says the pressure of losing weight isn’t unique to the entertainment industry. “I remember being in college and noticing all my friends around me dieting, trying to lose weight, talking about their changing bodies. That was the era of size zero when skinny was in, when there were ten different diets available on Google and everyone I knew was running on a treadmill. Becoming aware of your changing body as a young woman is completely natural, but health, nutrition, and building strength for the long run weren’t topics I grew up around. My world complimented weight loss and nothing else, not how you felt, not whether you’d gone hungry all day to look a certain way. I think the industry just amplifies something a lot of us already carry. Being on camera, being commented on, having your appearance be part of the job description. “ She points out that it can turn a normal relationship with your body into a much more complicated one if you’re not careful. “I don’t look back at any one moment or person with blame. I look back at a young woman who didn’t yet have the tools to separate how she looked from who she was, in an environment that made that separation harder than it needed to be. It was the slow realisation that I was spending all my energy managing something instead of living my life,” says Sana. The real turning point came when her reason for healing got bigger and she couldn't imagine her future, living with the disorder. She recalls, "I remember telling myself that if I got married, I’d never actually enjoy a date with my husband if I was busy worrying about food. That if I ever had children, I never wanted to pass this on. If any of that was going to be my future, I had to heal first.”

title: Remove Kala Hiran teaser, promotional content linked to Salman Khan, Delhi HC directs: ‘Reputation once lost is lost’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

In a big relief to star Salman Khan , the Delhi High Court has directed the removal of the teaser and several online links related to the soon-to-release Hindi movie Kala Hiran : The Battle for Legacy. The court held that the promotional material of the movie prima facie linked Salman with the 1998 blackbuck poaching case and could adversely affect his reputation.

Adding to this, A still from the teaser of Kala Hiran. Kala Hiran teaser to be taken down Hearing Salman Khan's application seeking an interim injunction against the rollout, promotion and publicity of the movie, Justice Jyoti Singh also indicated that interviews given by the movie's producer, Amit Jani , would be directed to be taken down.

Meanwhile, “This must stop,” the court orally remarked during the proceedings. “Reputation once lost is lost.” The court added that the promotional material appeared to connect the star with the Lawrence Bishnoi row.

Notably, Gangster Lawrence Bishnoi has repeatedly targeted Salman over the last few years, sending numerous death threats, calling for Salman to ‘apologise’ for his alleged role in the blackbuck poaching case.

As per the latest buzz, The star's case hinged on the claim that the movie's teaser, posters and related promotional material unmistakably identify the star despite not naming him directly. The plea shared that the teaser depicts a lookalike wearing Khan's signature blue bracelet, making him readily identifiable to the public. Salman contended that the movie is based on the 1998 blackbuck hunting case and falsely portrays events associated with him, causing serious prejudice to his reputation. He has also argued that the movie seeks to commercially exploit his identity and public persona without his consent.

In further updates, In addition, his plea further alleged that the movie's producer, Amit Jani, has explicitly connected the project with the blackbuck case and gangster Lawrence Bishnoi during interviews, social media posts, and public statements in an attempt to generate publicity. for the movie.

On top of that, Salman claimed that the movie infringes on his personality and publicity rights, even though his name is not used in the movie. However, he added that the posters, teaser and other promotional material contain clear visual and contextual references that make him readily identifiable.

The teaser also showed a character resembling the star holding a gun. Salman's plea shared that this created a misleading impression, as he was acquitted in the Arms Act case connected to the 1998 blackbuck poaching incident.
